parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates traveler-facing exposure: X/new mismatched passports restricted, visa cable directs refusal and possible fraud/permanent ineligibility on sex discrepancy, federal single-sex facility ban, and reported severe immigration-custody abuse. This state mitigates locally: no listed bathroom ban, Most Protective legislative tier, public-accommodations and hate-crime protections, X state documents, and a current care-shield law. However, local protections are largely paper statutes with no documented enforcement outcomes, shield invocation, or violence/prosecution data, and litigation leaves federal measures unevenly in force. Harshest operative federal rules therefore govern, placing it in elevated risk above the parent average but well below reduced-risk jurisdictions with demonstrated working remedies.
